_notes.estimated_quota_tokens: The 5-hour rolling quota is NOT queryable from any API. Leave null until you observe a real wall, then run `node bin/governor.js set-quota <tokens>` with the rolling-window spend at the moment it died. Tune over time.
_notes.soft_ceiling_pct: Background building should stay under this % of estimated quota by default.
_notes.halt_pct: At this %, halt all supervised projects, persist state, and check in with Chris.
_notes.reserve_tokens: Absolute floor never spent on background building — kept for live/urgent human needs (e.g. Augsburg-style rerouting).
